At outward drift, exact rare excursion success probability and uniform second moments give the renewal Laplace limit. value.rationale: This natural root-targeting benchmark quantifies how many independent local offers change optimal search from exponential to linear in tree height, with exact leading constants and different Gaussian versus exponential first-passage uncertainty. It is a meaningful asymptotic boundary for a standard choice-controlled walk on a parameterized graph class, not a one-off numerical constant. The published source notes only a qualitative 4-regular drift obstruction and general graph bounds.
